description: Lists CRM jobs (work orders), newest first by when the job was CREATED, and returns from, to, count, truncated, and items. Each item has id, createdAt, status, date (scheduled date), service, city, total (job total in dollars, 0 when not set), and customer. Use it for work created in a past period; use neuron_bookings for the upcoming appointment schedule by appointment date. It looks BACKWARD at creation time, defaults to the last 7 days ending now, permits a window of at most 90 days, and returns at most 500 jobs; truncated is true when the cap was reached. Test and synthetic records are excluded; this Neuron Expert MCP server tool is read-only, reads only the one business whose owner approved the connection and granted read:jobs on the consent screen, and returns JSON objects also as text. The limit is 60 requests per minute per connection, and a refused read returns a tool error with a short reason text.

from.description: Start of the creation-time window: ISO 8601 date or date-time. Default: 7 days before to; the window is at most 90 days.

to.description: End of the creation-time window: ISO 8601 date or date-time. Default: now.

name: neuron_jobs

total.description: Job total in the account currency (stored cents / 100).

truncated.description: True when the read stopped at its row cap (500; contact search 25).

title: List jobs
